sections.label: Twins in NICU and nursery
sections.summary: The speaker's twins were delivered successfully and spent about 10 weeks in hospital at SGH's NICU and High Dependency Unit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My twins were delivered successfully and spent about 10 weeks in hospital, at the SGH Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) and at the High Dependency Unit, also called the Special Care Nursery.

sections.label: Two weeks paternity leave insufficient
sections.summary: Two weeks of paternity leave are insufficient for fathers if their babies are in NICU that entire time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Clearly, two weeks of paternity leave are insufficient for us fathers if our babies are in NICU that entire time.

sections.label: Cecilia Tan's premature son's stay
sections.summary: Cecilia Tan's premature son spent 101 days in KK Women and Children's Hospital before being discharged.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Cecilia Tan's premature son spent 101 days in KK Women and Children's Hospital before being discharged.

sections.label: Eden Ang's daughter in hospital
sections.summary: Eden Ang's premature daughter was in the hospital during her entire 16 weeks of maternity leave.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Eden Ang's premature daughter was in the hospital during her entire 16 weeks of maternity leave.

sections.label: Extend parental leave for preterm babies
sections.summary: The speaker recommends extending parental leave for fathers and mothers to cover babies' time in NICU and the High Dependency Unit or Special Care Nursery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: For this first chapter of the journey, my recommendation is that we extend the parental leave for both fathers and mothers to at least cover the time the babies spend in NICU, if not the entire time the babies spent in both NICU and at the High Dependency Unit or Special Care Nursery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Several countries, such as Austria, Denmark, Italy, Germany, France, Spain, Israel, Colombia, New Zealand and India already provide extended leave for mothers and/or fathers of preterm babies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In New Zealand, for example, paid parental leave is extended by the period between actual and expected birth, for up to 13 weeks.

sections.label: Live births under 28 weeks
sections.summary: In 2015, out of 42,185 live births in Singapore, only 127 occurred at less than 28 weeks' gestation, or 0.3%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In 2015, out of 42,185 live births in Singapore, only 127 occurred at less than 28 weeks' gestation, which is only 0.3%.

sections.label: UK multiple birth mothers' sleep
sections.summary: A UK study found 8% of multiple birth mothers slept over six hours nightly in the first month, while 46% slept three to four hours.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: A study in the United Kingdom showed that only 8% of multiple birth mothers had more than six hours of sleep each night during the first month, while 46% slept less than three to four hours.

sections.label: Postnatal depression in multiple births
sections.summary: Some studies show 20% of multiple birth mothers had postnatal depression versus 10% of single birth mothers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Some studies also show that 20% of multiple birth mothers had suffered from postnatal depression, versus 10% of single birth mothers.

sections.label: Extending parental leave for multiples
sections.summary: The speaker recommends extending parental leave for both fathers and mothers with births of multiples.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My recommendation is that we extend the parental leave for both fathers and mothers with births of multiples.

sections.label: Singapore 2015 multiple births
sections.summary: Of 42,185 live births in Singapore in 2015, there were 1,249 twin births and 21 sets of triplets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Out of 42,185 live births in Singapore in 2015, there were only 1,249 twin births and 21 sets of triplets born.

sections.label: Speaker's twins and preterm help
sections.summary: The speaker describes his wife's emergency caesarean, expressing milk for twins, and hopes future parents of preterm babies or multiples get help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My wife had an emergency caesarean at night and, in the morning, she was up and about, going to see our twins already.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It is not easy expressing breast milk for one baby, but my amazing wife has managed to express enough milk for two babies for five months now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I also have a photo to prove this but I know she will definitely kill me if I show it to you.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We have all been through it and hope that future parents of preterm babies and/or births of multiples will get the additional help they so desperately need.

sections.label: Singapore 2016 multiple births
sections.summary: In 2016, there were 561 sets of twins and eight sets of triplets.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In 2016, there were 561 sets of twins and eight sets of triplets.

sections.label: Public sector parental leave pilot
sections.summary: The public sector will test longer parental leave for parents of infants through a three-year pilot.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: During the Committee of Supply debate this year, I had announced that the public sector will test the viability of longer parental leave for parents of infants, through a three-year pilot.

sections.label: Couples' public service leave
sections.summary: Couples with at least one spouse in the public service can have up to six months of leave between them.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In total, couples with at least one spouse in the public service can have up to six months of leave between them.

sections.label: Work-Life Grant and support
sections.summary: The Work-Life Grant funds employers up to $160,000 each over four years for flexible work arrangements, and support will be studied.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The Work-Life Grant provides employers with funding of up to $160,000 each over four years to help employers defray the costs of implementing and sustaining flexible work arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: This requires not just policy measures but also the support of employers, co-workers and family members.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We hear you, we appreciate the extraordinary trials and tribulations that you go through and you have my personal assurance that we will study ways to better support your families and we will seriously consider all of Mr Ng's suggestions.
